inputs.text: ABU DHABI, February 17, 2026 (WAM) – The National Center for Meteorology (NCM) has issued a weather warning regarding potential fog formation and significantly reduced horizontal visibility across several western regions of the UAE. According to the NCM statement released on Tuesday, visibility is expected to deteriorate—and may drop to zero at times—starting from 21:30 tonight until 10:00 AM Wednesday, February 18. The Center has urged motorists to exercise extreme caution on the roads. Drivers are advised to follow all traffic safety guidelines, maintain a safe distance from other vehicles, and strictly adhere to modified speed limits, particularly in areas experiencing thick fog.

fields.description: Fog warning: visibility may drop to zero at times in western regions from 21:30 tonight (Tue 17 Feb) until 10:00 AM Wednesday 18 Feb. Source: National Center for Meteorology.
fields.headline: Fog warning: visibility may drop to zero in western regions tonight until 10:00 Wednesday
fields.instruction: Drive with extreme caution, keep a safe distance from other vehicles and follow modified speed limits in thick fog. More info: https://alerts.example.ae
fields.note_for_reviewer: I chose severity Moderate because the source calls the fog potential, but visibility near zero on roads could justify Severe. Please also confirm that the operator's demo Western zone matches NCM's 'several western regions', since the source does not name specific areas.

payload.summary: The alert matches the verified NCM bulletin. The hazard is fog with reduced visibility that may drop to zero at times. The times are 21:30 Tue 17 Feb until 10:00 Wed 18 Feb, and the area is western regions of the UAE. Certainty 'Likely' fits 'visibility is expected to deteriorate'. Severity 'Moderate' (possible threat to life or property) is not higher than the bulletin supports. The instructions repeat NCM's motorist advice, and the alert includes no unverified reports.

payload.summary: Nothing in my mandate is wrong. The sender is in the issuer register at level 1 with all areas and categories allowed. The alert area (Western region demo zone, DEMO-ZONE/AUH-WEST) matches the area drawn for event uae-fog-2026-02-17. Status 'Actual' fits a real event on the live console. msgType 'Alert' with no references is correct for a first alert, since no earlier alerts exist from this system. There are no active alerts from other authorities for it to overreach. The register lists the sender as a demo stand-in for the real issuer (NCEMA under the National Early Warning System); the people approving should keep that in mind.

objections.fix: Add a short protective action right after the hazard in both languages, within the first page: for example 'Avoid driving; if you must, slow down, keep distance and use low-beam lights' and its Arabic equivalent. Move or shorten the source and date details if they push the action off page 1.
objections.issue: Neither the English nor the Arabic phone text contains a protective action. Only the hazard, area, time and source are given, so the first page that handset users see does not tell them what to do.

payload.summary: The Arabic headline, description and instruction match the English in meaning. The hazard (fog, visibility possibly dropping to zero at times), the area (western regions), the times (from 21:30 Tue 17 Feb until 10:00 AM Wed 18 Feb), the source (National Center for Meteorology) and the protective actions all match. The protective actions are: drive with extreme caution, keep a safe distance and follow modified speed limits in thick fog. The URL is identical. No differences in meaning were found. The Arabic was produced by machine translation, so a named Arabic-reading person at the issuing authority must still review and approve it before sending.

Please confirm that the operator's 'Western region (demo zone)' matches NCM's 'several western regions', and check whether Severe/Likely is the right level for potential zero-visibility fog.
